pages.text: Gear to your ceiling before you knock. Cataclysm's massive T3-T4 dungeon structures hold the pack's ultra-boss encounters and their unique materials.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Cataclysm is the hardest T3 content: five ultra-bosses (Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, The Harbinger, The Leviathan, Maledictus), each in an enormous structure built for it.$(br2)$(bold)Loot:$() Cataclysm structures have some of the highest token drop rates in T3, and the materials from Cataclysm bosses are among the best T3 crafting components.

$(bold)Prep requirement:$() Full terrasteel or enderium gear is the recommended minimum for a Cataclysm boss attempt. Maledictus and The Harbinger in particular are tuned for well-geared T3 players.$(br2)$(bold)Unique weapons:$() Cataclysm bosses drop 8 Simply Swords uniques, more than any other single mod.

$(bold)No guide book.$() Cataclysm is about its bosses, and you learn them by fighting them. Each boss drops a $(bold)Trophy$() you can place for display, and JEI covers every weapon and armor recipe the boss materials unlock.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Netherite Monstrosity$(), the entry ultra-boss ($(l:icraft:bosses/t3_bosses)Tier 3 Bosses$(/l)).
